scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,feed,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @mtv/db" "npm run dev -w @mtv/feed" "npm run dev -w @mtv/web"
scripts.build: npm run generate -w @mtv/db && npm run build --workspace @mtv/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n db,feed,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @mtv/db" "npm run start -w @mtv/feed" "npm run start -w @mtv/web"
scripts.app: concurrently -n feed,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @mtv/feed" "npm run start -w @mtv/web"
